<div class="card-body">
'''Hyper Escape''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ハイパー・エスケープ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">星系で戦闘が宣言された時に使う。通常と同じフォースを消費して、自分の宇宙船を全部移動させることができれば、戦闘はキャンセルされる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-88o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「ハイパースペースへ突入しちまえば、安全だ。」ビーコンでも取り付けられていない限り、ハイパースペースに入った宇宙船を追跡する手段はない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hyper Escape.

'''Card text:''' Use when a battle is declared at a system. If you can move all of your starships away, using Force as usual, the battle is canceled.

'''Lore:''' “We'll be safe enough once we jump to hyperspace.” Unless a beacon is planted, there is no way to track a starship that has entered hyperspace.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese cancels the battle if you can move all your starships away; the English cancels by moving them away.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hyper Escape]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
